title: Chenodiol
overview:
Chenodiol is used to help dissolve a certain type of gallstones. It is also used to treat people with cerebrotendinous xanthomatosis (CTX; a condition that causes high levels of cholesterol in the body). Chenodiol is in a class of medications called bile acids.
It works by dissolving cholesterol that makes gallstones. It also stops production of cholesterol in the liver.
